:::{#exm-diagonal-problem}
#### Machines in and out of the diagonal problem

If $w$ [describes](models-of-computation.qmd#def-tm-description) a machine that [outputs](models-of-computation.qmd#def-turing-machine) $1$ on every input,
then $M_w(w) = 1$, so $w$ is not in [UC](#def-diagonal-problem).
If $w$ describes a machine that outputs $0$ on every input,
or one that runs forever on every input,
then $w$ is in UC.
If $w$ describes the palindrome machine of
[the palindrome example](models-of-computation.qmd#exm-palindrome-machine),
then $w$ is in UC exactly when $w$ is not itself a palindrome.

:::
